ESTF.vllm_implementation_or_control: Client-side external admission controller using estimated prompt+predicted-output service ranking; no current internal vLLM scheduler hook verified locally.
ESTF.notes: Faithful to this repo's ESTF policy logic as an external admission layer, not exact replacement of vLLM's internal scheduler.

WFS.vllm_implementation_or_control: Possible client-side external admission controller using class deficit, priority, and service estimate; current real-vLLM harness does not list weighted_fair_share among WIRED_POLICIES.
WFS.notes: Would require small harness wiring and careful class/debt bookkeeping before a fair real run.

LLF.vllm_implementation_or_control: Client-side external admission controller already listed in the real-vLLM harness as least_laxity_first.
LLF.notes: Uses observable deadlines and predicted service before admission; internal vLLM batching remains unchanged.

chunked_full_prefill.vllm_implementation_or_control: Actual vLLM server flags: --enable-chunked-prefill versus --disable-chunked-prefill, with max_num_batched_tokens/max_num_seqs/max_model_len/block_size held fixed.
chunked_full_prefill.notes: This is the strongest local real-system target because it uses native vLLM controls rather than approximating via client-side ranking.

KV_aware_scheduling.vllm_implementation_or_control: KV pressure can be measured through vLLM metrics and induced through max_model_len/gpu_memory_utilization/max_num_seqs, but a faithful KV-aware request scheduler is not exposed by the current harness.
KV_aware_scheduling.notes: Prior local 0.5B stress reached queueing but only 2.1% KV usage; prior 7B A100 xlong reached 83.7% KV usage.

queue_wait.vllm_implementation_or_control: vLLM Prometheus metrics vllm:num_requests_waiting plus client-side admission timestamps.
queue_wait.notes: Prior local stress saw waiting in 8/8 scenarios.

SLO_goodput.vllm_implementation_or_control: Harness-level deadline/priority scoring over real request completion and first-token timing.
SLO_goodput.notes: SLOs are experimental workload labels, not vLLM-native SLO enforcement.

KV_pressure.vllm_implementation_or_control: vLLM Prometheus kv_cache_usage_perc metric and preemption counters.
KV_pressure.notes: Measurement is exact where metric is exposed; inducing high pressure locally is not yet shown feasible.
